# RocketCDN
> RocketCDN is a content delivery network service by WP Rocket that accelerates website asset delivery through a global edge network.

RocketCDN focuses on simple CDN integration for WordPress and other websites, with setup guidance, account management resources, and support documentation centered on activation, configuration, billing, and troubleshooting.

## Getting Started
- [RocketCDN](https://rocket-cdn.com/): Main product page with overview, pricing, and core CDN performance benefits.
- [How to Get Started with RocketCDN](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1497-how-to-get-started-with-rocketcdn): Step-by-step setup guide for activating and connecting RocketCDN.
- [RocketCDN Requirements](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1498-rocketcdn-requirements): Technical and account prerequisites for using RocketCDN successfully.
- [RocketCDN Dashboard](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1499-rocketcdn-dashboard): Overview of the RocketCDN dashboard and available management options.

## Setup and Configuration
- [Enable RocketCDN](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1500-enable-rocketcdn): Instructions for enabling RocketCDN on a website using WP Rocket.
- [CNAME Setup for RocketCDN](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1501-cname-setup-for-rocketcdn): Guidance for configuring a custom CNAME with RocketCDN.
- [Using RocketCDN Without WP Rocket](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1502-using-rocketcdn-without-wp-rocket): Setup instructions for sites not using the WP Rocket plugin.
- [Exclude Files from RocketCDN](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1503-exclude-files-from-rocketcdn): How to prevent selected assets from being served through the CDN.
- [Clear RocketCDN Cache](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1504-clear-rocketcdn-cache): Steps to purge cached files and refresh CDN-served content.

## Account and Billing
- [RocketCDN Pricing](https://rocket-cdn.com/pricing/): Pricing information for RocketCDN plans and included usage allowances.
- [Manage Your RocketCDN Subscription](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1505-manage-your-rocketcdn-subscription): How to view, update, or cancel a RocketCDN subscription.
- [RocketCDN Billing and Invoices](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1506-rocketcdn-billing-and-invoices): Information about payments, invoices, and billing management.
- [Renew Your RocketCDN Subscription](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1507-renew-your-rocketcdn-subscription): Guidance for renewing an active or expired RocketCDN plan.
- [Refund Policy](https://rocket-cdn.com/refund-policy/): Terms covering refunds and eligibility for RocketCDN purchases.

## Troubleshooting
- [RocketCDN Troubleshooting](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1508-rocketcdn-troubleshooting): Common issues and fixes for setup, delivery, and cache behavior.
- [RocketCDN Is Not Rewriting URLs](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1509-rocketcdn-is-not-rewriting-urls): Troubleshooting steps when asset URLs are not rewritten to the CDN.
- [Mixed Content with RocketCDN](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1510-mixed-content-with-rocketcdn): Solutions for HTTPS and mixed content problems on CDN assets.
- [404 Errors on RocketCDN Assets](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1511-404-errors-on-rocketcdn-assets): How to diagnose missing files and CDN asset delivery errors.
- [DNS Propagation and CNAME Issues](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/article/1512-dns-propagation-and-cname-issues): Help for DNS delays and custom hostname configuration problems.

## Support and Help
- [RocketCDN Help Center](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/category/228-rocketcdn): Central documentation category for RocketCDN articles and support topics.
- [Contact Support](https://rocket-cdn.com/contact/): Contact page for reaching the RocketCDN or WP Rocket support team.
- [WP Rocket Documentation](https://docs.wp-rocket.me/): Main documentation portal covering WP Rocket and RocketCDN resources.
- [My Account](https://rocket-cdn.com/my-account/): Account area for managing subscriptions, billing, and service access.

## Legal and Policies
- [Terms of Service](https://rocket-cdn.com/terms/): Legal terms governing use of the RocketCDN service and website.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rocket-cdn.com/privacy-policy/): Policy describing data collection, processing, and privacy practices.
- [Cookie Policy](https://rocket-cdn.com/cookie-policy/): Information about cookies and tracking technologies used on the site.
- [Imprint](https://rocket-cdn.com/imprint/): Company and publisher information for legal identification.
